name: Robert "ProXy" Kruczek
biography: I am a Cybersecurity Consultant, Mentor, and Ethical Hacker (known in the infosec community as ProXy) at Securitum - Poland's leading cybersecurity firm - and a contributor to sekurak.pl, the country's largest infosec portal. With over 10 years of experience in vulnerability research and penetration testing. Operating under the ProXy alias, I discovered and reported 43 CVEs and I am an active Bug Bounty hunter (Hall of Fame at OLX, reports for BlaBlaCar, OVH, and ERCOM).
